Structuring pattern observed: multiple transactions below $10,000 threshold. Account ACC-10088 frozen, chargeback initiated under Reg E reason code 10.4. Wire recall in progress for $9,950 pending transfer to Hong Kong. Graph analysis revealed shell company Petrov Trading LLC and shared Delaware agent at high-risk address. No prior SARs for customer. Risk rating updated to high.

data.narrative_summary: Customer reported unauthorized purchase of 2.5 BTC ($42,500) via CryptoXchange Pro (MCC 6051). Transaction originated from account ACC-10088 with no prior crypto activity. Graph analysis revealed layered fund flows through intermediary accounts (ACC-10042, ACC-10099) to offshore beneficiaries in Cyprus and UAE. Rapid transaction velocity (4 transactions in 51 minutes), structuring pattern below $10K, and cross-border wire activity indicate potential money laundering. Account freeze and chargeback initiated. Wire recall in progress for pending $9,950 wire to Hong Kong. No external fraud database matches, but entity network shows shared registered agent and shell company links. SAR filed per 31 CFR 1020.320.
